text:
incident-bot: PAGED: P1 uk-south GPU pool exhausted, autoscaler blocked. queue growth > 95% for 10m, multiple customer requests failing. paging oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: seeing a large backlog on dedicated-pool-uksouth, autoscaler stuck in Provisioning state. health checks show nodes not joining.

sanjay: I'm on it. last API error when the scaler attempted to request new instances: 
```
AllocationFailed: AllocationFailed - VM Scale Set request failed: RegionQuotaExceeded. Subscription quota for GPU SKUs in region UK South reached.
```

matt: which SKU hit the quota? we usually use NVidia A100-80GB / NCasT4_v3 variants depending on config. can you paste the VMSS scale request?

sanjay: looks like `Standard_NC24s_v3` was requested repeatedly. quota shows 0 available for that SKU. running `az vm list-usage -l "UK South"` returns the GPU quota at max.

iris: customer impact? which customers are on dedicated-pool-uksouth?

amelia-support: two enterprise customers (acme-inc, fintechx) report timeouts; support tickets opened and flagged as Sev1. internal metrics: 99th percentile latency for those customers spiked from ~120ms to ~2.3s and request failures increased 7%.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigations I'm doing now: 1) pause new job admission to that pool; 2) enable fallback routing to eu-west3 for non-data-residency constrained customers; 3) kick warm-up in eu-west3 warm pool. will update in 2-3m.

kai: is bypassing to eu-west3 safe for those customers? any compliance flags?

amelia-support: acme-inc is fine to move regionally, fintechx is NOT—must stay in UK region. fintechx will be impacted until we get quota or a workaround.

eva: trying a short-term workaround: can we spin smaller instances (multi-GPU split) or fallback to a quantized CPU path for fintechx to keep requests alive (degraded quality)?

sanjay: tried spinning mixed SKU (T4s) but our model flavors for fintechx were pinned to A100 class and don't run acceptably on T4. CPU-quantized path is possible but will increase latency and drop throughput; we can enable a temporary degraded profile.

oncall-sre: I've opened an Azure support case from portal: case 2026-UKS-987654. Azure replied with initial acknowledgement and says "quota increase possible but may take 4-8 hours". their quick fix: reassign unused quotas from other subscriptions in same tenant (we don't have spare).

matt: steps to reduce immediate queue: 1) admission control to stop new long-running batches, 2) retry/backoff for SDK clients, 3) force-promote warmpool in eu-west3. already started 1 and 3.

incident-bot: NOTE: runbook invoked: `gpu-quota-hit-uk` (link: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-quota-hit-uk).

oncall-sre: performing safe drain for low-priority batch jobs in pool to free up slots for realtime requests. starting drain...

sanjay: quick log dump from scaler controller: 
```
2026-05-14T09:02:11Z scaler: request scale up size=8 sku=Standard_NC24s_v3 -> AzureError(AllocationFailed: AllocationFailed - VM Scale Set request failed: RegionQuotaExceeded)
2026-05-14T09:03:02Z scaler: retries exhausted, marking pool autoscale=frozen
```

eva: created a temporary model profile `finetune-lite-uk-degrade` which runs on smaller GPU config with aggressive quantization. quality drop predicted ~5-8% on our eval set. can deploy if ops ok with degraded SLA.

amelia-support: fintechx has legal restrictions. need explicit approval before moving data out of UK region. suggest we open emergency legal + customer comms thread. I'll draft.

oncall-sre: short term customer comm: status update to fintechx that we're investigating GPU capacity in UK South and may need to serve degraded model until quota increase is applied. Amelia, please coordinate.

azure-bot: Automated note: detected 4 orphaned GPU instances in subscription that can be reclaimed. Reclaiming may free 2 NVidia A100 equivalent slots.
sanjay: reclaim in progress. if reclaim succeeds we might free up 2 slots. still not enough for all pending jobs.

matt: can we enable lower-concurrency per-host to allow more containers across VMs? Might let us squeeze requests until quota resolved.
oncall-sre: changing per-host concurrency to 8 from 16 for real-time runtime. doing a rolling config change now.

incident-bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: [pause-admissions], [fallback-eu-west3], [reclaim-orphans], [open-azure-case-2026-UKS-987654], [customer-comms-fintechx].

sanjay: reclaim freed 2 slots, rolling concurrency change applied. queue length dropped ~30% but still 60% of capacity used.

eva: deploying `finetune-lite-uk-degrade` behind a feature flag for fintechx as last resort if quota not increased. needs product approval.

amelia-support: drafting outbound to fintechx: short note + expected timeline (4-8h) + degraded options. will send after legal ok.

oncall-sre: next steps: 1) continue Azure case escalation (request express review), 2) prioritize realtime traffic and keep batch queues paused, 3) monitor queue metric and customer SLA, 4) if quota not increased in 3 hours, flip fintechx to degrade path (with customer consent).

matt: if Azure can't expedite, we should prepare a manual cold-failover to a dedicated eu-west3 replica private infra for fintechx; that'll take ~2h ops work including DNS and KMS handshake. keep that as last-resort.

amelia-support: Customer comm drafted. awaiting legal sign-off. will post copy here before send.

oncall-sre: status update in 15m. tagging ops rotation for handoff: @matt for the next 2h window.

incident-bot: THREAD STATUS: open, severity=P1, impacted-customers=[acme-inc, fintechx], mitigations=partial, azure-case=2026-UKS-987654.

matt: ack. I'll take lead on manual failover if required.

iris: thanks everyone — please add all actions to the incident tracker and mark any customer-communication messages before sending.

amelia-support: legal gave conditional approval for a degraded model only if we get written customer consent. reaching out to fintechx now (will ping here).

azure-bot: Update: support case escalated to "Quota Operations" team; estimated review in 90-180 minutes.

oncall-sre: final for now — reclaimed nodes + concurrency change + fallback routing reduced immediate failure rate. still monitoring for QoS regressions. standing by for Azure case update.

amelia-support: fintechx replied: willing to trial degraded model for 1 hour while we fix quota, wants visibility into error rates. sending them the monitoring dashboard link and ETA.

incident-bot: last recorded update at 2026-05-14T09:22:00Z.
